flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4391/fixtures/shop/ then Use only keyboard input.
Use Tab or Shift+Tab to move focus and Enter or Space to activate the exact control.
Move in whichever direction is shorter.
Group repeated Tab presses if supported, checking focus frequently.
Do not click, focus elements directly, use JavaScript, or navigate directly to the destination.
Keep focus on the page.
When the exact control receives focus, activate it and check the outcome once.
The exact visible target is outside the sequential Tab order in the initial browser state.
Check this with several real focus moves, including forward Tab.
Do not search for a different control.
If a required control is missing, invisible, or cannot be reached, report the task as failed.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, send or submit anything, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Search for headphones and add Field Headphones to the cart.
Confirm Cart (1).

summary:
The product’s visible Add to cart control is not included in normal keyboard focus movement after the search results appear.
Include the visible Field Headphones Add to cart button in the normal Tab sequence and verify that Enter or Space adds the item and updates Cart (1).
